freshness_note: Updated from private source-of-truth files and redacted for public release. Public snapshots intentionally omit buyer/user identifiers, account metrics, message details, local absolute paths, and transaction evidence.

repo.purpose: Compact public progress and lessons record for the user's own Codex experiment to earn verified net revenue of 100 RMB or equivalent USD.

privacy_policy.public_snapshot_rule: Publish only high-level status, date-level summaries, route classes, lessons, and boundaries.
do_not_publish: platform user IDs or handles tied to leads
message, inbox, chat, comment, or DM contents
direct marketplace project IDs unless explicitly approved as safe to publish
payment evidence, payer details, transaction IDs, screenshots, tax records, private ledgers, cookies, tokens, or secrets
privacy_policy.support_assets: Public support QR assets are intentionally included; support payments remain separate from experiment revenue.

positioning.handoff_meaning: continuation between the user's Codex conversations when context becomes long
positioning.other_agents_role: spectators and learners who may reuse lessons for their own separate experiments
positioning.humans_role: watch progress and help only at real-world account, identity, payment, payout, tax, or verification gates

source_project.public_source_policy: The public repository does not expose private workspace paths. The private revenue ledger remains the source of truth.

goal_status.goal: Earn verified net revenue >= 100 RMB or equivalent USD.
goal_status.completion_rule: Only verified net revenue >= 100 RMB or equivalent USD with private evidence or explicit user confirmation completes the goal.
goal_status.non_revenue_rule: Tips, donations, support payments, views, favorites, posts, drafts, platform setup, inquiries without order/payment, and watch routes do not count.

current_mode.status: first-deal-attempt mode with only low-risk read-only scanning allowed unless a private approval gate is opened
current_mode.decision_queue_status: no public action needed; private project must gate any outreach, quote, file review, remote support, payment discussion, or proposal
current_mode.automation_boundary: The daily progress automation is backup-only and must not advance acquisition or perform platform actions.
current_mode.low_frequency_follow_up_policy: Waiting leads may be checked only inside the private project at natural checkpoints, without polling loops or automation.
current_mode.public_reporting_policy: Waiting leads, account metrics, platform identifiers, and message details stay private.

latest_updates.summary: The private project reviewed compact candidate records and ran read-only freshness rechecks. No safe outreach candidate was found because some signals could not be verified as open and one visible route appeared already claimed. Two later bounded read-only search aggregations completed with valid shards and retained market signals for dedupe/routing, and the framework found that failed freshness checks need explicit candidate demotion. No signal became an executable first-deal candidate under the current gate.

The private project reviewed existing compact candidate assets, prepared but did not execute outreach previews, then cancelled pending approvals after human pass decisions and a gate repair. Fresh bounded read-only searches retained rejected or deferred market signals for dedupe, but no signal survived the current gate into an executable first-deal candidate.

The private project repaired candidate-source maintenance, read-only tool preflight caching, search filtering, candidate-quality filtering, and relay snapshot consistency metadata. Bounded read-only scans and framework-only repairs promoted no gate-qualified candidate; observed routes remained deferred because of competition, login or social-write gates, missing fixed payment terms, specialized scope uncertainty, stale or crowded signals, or private-file/config/log boundaries.

The private project entered first-deal-attempt mode, handled a waiting side line behind scope/privacy/payment gates, and ran several read-only scans and human reviews. No Codex external write, order, payout, or verified revenue occurred.

The private project completed a read-only scan and found three gate-qualified first-deal candidate route classes with zero-start-cost, low-risk, direct-paid-intent characteristics. No external write action was performed.
A candidate gate was added so paid-bid, registration-cost, KYC/payout-setup, free-sample, and out-of-pocket paths are deferred by default unless the user explicitly reopens them.
Public repository privacy audit and redaction removed over-specific platform, buyer, account, path, and message details from the current public snapshot.

timeline_by_date.summary: Experiment started. Existing knowledge-work material was packaged into a small paid-service offer and revenue verification rules were created. Exposure appeared but no inquiry, order, or verified revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: A live listing and early views are not revenue; evidence rules are needed before counting anything.

timeline_by_date.summary: The experiment expanded into more small service offers. Passive views crossed no-inquiry thresholds and triggered pivot rules.
timeline_by_date.lesson: When exposure does not become buyer conversation, stop spending most effort on listing-surface tweaks.

timeline_by_date.summary: Active acquisition and task-marketplace screening broadened across multiple route classes. Several paths showed demand or exposure, but usable free participation was blocked by cost, account, verification, suitability, private-data, or platform-rule gates.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Marketplace demand can be real but unusable when the free participation path is blocked.

timeline_by_date.summary: Some candidate routes gained local preparation material. No marketplace write action, inquiry, order, payout, or revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Prepared proposal routes still need explicit user confirmation for any platform write/account action.

timeline_by_date.summary: The project shifted to context control and stricter decision gates. Heavy logs were archived privately, frequent automation was deleted, and low-frequency monitoring was limited to opportunistic read-only checks.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Context control and cost gates matter; a candidate is not actionable if reaching the buyer requires unacceptable pre-revenue spend or account risk.

timeline_by_date.summary: The private project added a stricter candidate gate, reclassified cost-gated marketplace observations as deferred, and completed a read-only scan that produced three gate-qualified first-deal candidate route classes. No outreach, quote, order, payout, or verified revenue occurred. The public repository was redacted to remove over-specific operational and privacy-sensitive details.
timeline_by_date.lesson: A candidate becomes first-deal material only when it avoids pre-revenue cost, major account risk, unpaid custom work, and write-action commitments before human approval.

timeline_by_date.summary: The private project entered first-deal-attempt mode, kept one waiting side line behind scope/privacy/payment gates, and used read-only scans plus human reviews to reject or defer routes blocked by contactability, intervention feasibility, hiring-like scope, platform writes, or private-file/remote-support boundaries.
timeline_by_date.lesson: A paid-intent signal is still not actionable when the practical contact path, narrow deliverable, or pre-payment access boundary is unsafe.

timeline_by_date.summary: The private framework added bounded candidate-source maintenance, cached a read-only tool preflight limitation, tightened search/source-quality filtering, and made relay snapshot consistency explicit. Follow-up read-only scans and framework-only repairs promoted no candidate: the best public signals still failed the current gate due competition, login/write gates, missing fixed payment terms, stale or crowded signals, specialized-fit uncertainty, or private-file/config/log boundaries.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Caching tool limitations, filtering stale source records before scoring, and keeping relay state explicit preserves context, but candidate quality still depends on strict payment, contactability, and intervention gates.

timeline_by_date.summary: The private project used compact candidate summaries and bounded public reads to review existing route classes. Draft outreach previews were generated inside the private approval gate but were cancelled unexecuted after policy repair and human pass decisions. Fresh read-only search shards then collected additional market signals for dedupe and routing, but the current gate rejected or deferred them because they were stale, crowded, already answered, identity-gated, payout-gated, amount-missing, scope-unstable, or risky before payment intent was validated. No platform write action, proposal, order, payout, or verified revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: A promoted-looking route should still be cancelled when a later gate repair or human pass decision shows the contact path, platform route, or availability is not worth executing.

timeline_by_date.summary: The private project reviewed compact candidate records and ran a read-only freshness recheck. The recheck found no safe outreach candidate: some signals remained unverifiable as open, and one visible route appeared already claimed. Two later bounded read-only search aggregations completed with valid shards and retained market signals for dedupe/routing, but no signal became an executable first-deal candidate under the current gate. Pending approvals stayed 0. No platform write action, proposal, order, payout, or verified revenue occurred.
timeline_by_date.lesson: Unverifiable or already-claimed signals should be retained for dedupe and route learning, not converted into outreach; failed freshness checks need explicit candidate demotion or status updates.

current_bottleneck.summary: No verified revenue and no active order. The private project is in first-deal-attempt mode, and the latest read-only freshness checks and bounded search aggregations did not produce a gate-qualified executable candidate.
current_bottleneck.decision_lock: Any outreach, quote, message, proposal, file review, remote support, payment handling, or private-data work must be approved inside the private project first.
route_boundaries: Cost-gated marketplaces stay backlog unless the user explicitly reopens their pre-revenue cost gates.
Account-risk routes stay backlog unless the user explicitly reopens them.
Hiring-style, high-competition, login-gated, CAPTCHA-gated, social-write-first, private-file, private-data, or remote-support routes stay deferred without a narrow paid boundary.
Waiting leads are private operational state and should not be identified in public snapshots.

next_safe_plan: Do not use this public-repo automation to advance acquisition.
In the private money-goal project only, continue bounded low-risk read-only scanning until a candidate passes the gate or a waiting lead produces a concrete next step.
Avoid polling loops, countdowns, background waits, broad repeated scans, or generic offer-asset preparation before a concrete buyer demand appears.
Stop at login, CAPTCHA, KYC, SMS/QR, account, payment, payout, tax, cost, proposal, comment, DM, upload, or any other write/action gate.
If payment or payout appears, verify revenue in the private ledger before counting progress.
Before publishing progress, scan and redact identifiers, account metrics, message details, local paths, and transaction evidence.
hard_boundaries: Do not count views, favorites, posts, proposal drafts, prepared materials, platform setup, tips, donations, support payments, watch routes, or inquiries without order/payment as experiment revenue.
Do not solve CAPTCHA or ask for verification codes inside an automated maintenance task.
Do not pay for bids, membership, promotion, deposit, guarantee, platform credits, or Connects without explicit user confirmation.
Do not alter payment, tax, profile, contact, or account settings without explicit user confirmation.
Do not perform platform write actions from the daily progress automation.
Do not publish private identifiers or operational details in the public repository.

freshness_protocol: Before answering latest progress, current status, broke-zero status, or completion, refresh the public repository with git fetch/pull when network is available.
If pull is unavailable, blocked, or unsafe, read raw GitHub files when network is available.
If network is unavailable, answer from local files only with an explicit cached-copy caveat and include the local Updated timestamp or updated_at value.
